description: This PHP class defines an Accounting number format wizard for PhpSpreadsheet, handling currency formatting with locale support and ICU version checks.

classes.name: Accounting
classes.description: A class extending Currency to provide accounting number formatting with locale and ICU support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Accounting formatter with currency code, decimals, separator, symbol position, spacing, and locale.

methods.name: getLocaleFormat
methods.description: Generates the locale-specific accounting format string, with ICU and PHP version checks.

methods.name: icuVersion
methods.description: Returns the ICU version as a float.

methods.name: formatCurrencyCode
methods.description: Returns the formatted currency code string, considering locale.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the final formatted accounting string based on locale and settings.
